steps: Check the water panel/evaporator pad for mineral scale buildup.
Replace the pad if it's stiff, cracked, or heavily scaled.
Clean the reservoir with a vinegar-water solution to remove mold.
Verify the humidistat setting matches the season (lower in winter to avoid condensation).
Run a full cycle and confirm water flow and shutoff work correctly.
